1. [blocking] `math.js:2`: `add(a, b)` now returns `a - b` instead of `a + b`. The function name, its signature, and its previous behavior all promise addition, so every caller now gets wrong results; for example, `add(2, 3)` returns `-1` instead of `5`. The diff changes no callers and no tests to match. Nothing in the diff suggests the change is intentional, so this reads as a typo. The fix is to restore `return a + b;`.
